acceptanceCriteria: The reproduction above: the gap clears (or is replaced by a weaker, distinct gap such as `asserting-e2e-tests-unauthenticated-review`).
A test asserts the *absence* of `missing-asserting-e2e-tests` for a fixture that satisfies the documented rule (today the suite only asserts its presence).
A relation with `join_confidence: "inferred"` or `role: "related"` still yields the gap.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1245 (filed 2026-10-19 against build main-fa8afe6). `docs_gaps` emits `missing-asserting-e2e-tests` for a flow unless one of its relations has an exact, asserting `test_link` whose evidence `Trust == "reviewed"`. But provider evidence that declares `trust: "reviewed"` is always rewritten during import to `Trust = "generated"` with `ReportedTrust = "reviewed"`, and no other code path sets `Trust = "reviewed"` on a relation. The clearing condition is unreachable, so every flow in every corpus reports `missing-asserting-e2e-tests`, regardless of how well it is tested. (Found by source reading; consistent with every flow in a 159-flow corpus reporting the gap.)
title: missing-asserting-e2e-tests gap can never clear: requires trust reviewed which import rewrites to generated (GitHub #1245)
